description: Get a model-generated answer grounded in this knowledge base. For source evidence to reason over yourself, use get_context_pack instead. Selects relevant pages, loads them, and returns a grounded answer with citations. Set save=true to request publication as a wiki page; citation or profile refusals return the answer with publicationRefusal and no saved slug. Set debug=true to include the selected chunks and their scores. Requires an LLM provider.

debug.description: Include retrieval debug info (selected chunks/pages + scores).

save.description: Request a wiki/queries/ page; publication requires fresh citation validation.

name: query_wiki
title: Query Wiki
